ruleDefinitions.name: Flush Iptables Ufw Chain
ruleDefinitions.description: Detect use of iptables to flush all firewall rules, tables and chains and allow all network traffic

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\/iptables$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/xtables\\-legacy\\-multi$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/iptables\\-legacy\\-multi$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/ip6tables$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/ip6tables\\-legacy\\-multi$")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-F.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-Z.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-X.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*ufw\\-logging\\-deny.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*ufw\\-logging\\-allow.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*ufw6\\-logging\\-deny.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*ufw6\\-logging\\-allow.*")))
